// CASE ts_worker_spread_push_single expect=pass
export async function a<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number[]>, out: number[]) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      out.push(...await operation(items[index]));
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_wrapped_single_control expect=pass
export async function b<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number[]>, out: number[][]) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      out.push(await operation(items[index]));
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_spread_dup expect=fire
export async function c<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<number[]>, out: number[]) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      out.push(...(await operation(items[index])), ...await operation(items[index]));
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_regex_quote_dup expect=fire
export async function d<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<string>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      merge((await operation(items[index])).replace(/'/g, ""), await operation(items[index]), 'x');
    }
  }));
}
// CASE ts_worker_object_key_await_single expect=pass
export async function e<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      record({ await: await operation(items[index]) });
    }
  }));
}
